intro.uz: Madina bir hafta telefonsiz yashab koʻradi. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz bir kun telefonsiz yasha olasizmi?

paragraphs.en: Last month, our English teacher gave us a strange task: live for one week without a phone. Most students in my class laughed, but I decided to try. My name is Madina, and I am sixteen. Before that week, I spent about five hours a day on my phone.
paragraphs.uz: Oʻtgan oy ingliz tili oʻqituvchimiz bizga gʻalati topshiriq berdi: bir hafta telefonsiz yashash. Sinfimizdagi koʻp oʻquvchilar kulishdi, lekin men sinab koʻrishga qaror qildim. Mening ismim Madina, oʻn olti yoshdaman. Oʻsha haftagacha kuniga taxminan besh soatni telefonda oʻtkazardim.

paragraphs.en: The first two days were terrible. I didn't know the time, so I was late for school on Monday. In the evenings I felt bored and lonely. I wanted to check my messages every ten minutes.
paragraphs.uz: Dastlabki ikki kun dahshatli oʻtdi. Soat nechaligini bilmadim, shuning uchun dushanba kuni maktabga kechikdim. Kechqurunlari zerikdim va oʻzimni yolgʻiz his qildim. Har oʻn daqiqada xabarlarimni tekshirgim kelardi.

paragraphs.en: On Wednesday, things got better. I found an old book on my sister's shelf and read it in two days. I also helped my grandmother in the garden, and she told me funny stories about her school years. I have never laughed so much with her!
paragraphs.uz: Chorshanba kuni ishlar yaxshilandi. Opamning javonidan eski bir kitob topib, uni ikki kunda oʻqib chiqdim. Bogʻda buvimga ham yordam berdim, u menga maktab yillari haqida kulgili voqealarni aytib berdi. U bilan hech qachon bunchalik koʻp kulmagan edim!

paragraphs.en: By the end of the week, I was sleeping better and I wasn't so tired in the morning. I also spent more time with my family. We talked at dinner instead of looking at our screens.
paragraphs.uz: Hafta oxiriga kelib yaxshiroq uxlay boshladim va ertalab unchalik charchamasdim. Oilam bilan ham koʻproq vaqt oʻtkaza boshladim. Kechki ovqatda ekranlarga qarash oʻrniga suhbatlashdik.

paragraphs.en: Now I have my phone again, but I'm going to use it less. I put it in another room at night, and I read before bed. It was one of the best weeks of my life.
paragraphs.uz: Hozir telefonim yana oʻzimda, lekin undan kamroq foydalanmoqchiman. Kechasi uni boshqa xonaga qoʻyaman, uxlashdan oldin kitob oʻqiyman. Bu hayotimdagi eng yaxshi haftalardan biri boʻldi.
